Bundles core and gateway 0.16.27, with less copying during streaming and replay, smaller checkpoint storage, and shared plaintext compaction across model providers. Gateway diagnostics remain available from the app's bundled gateway. Transcript errors use a quieter presentation, and live reasoning, compaction notices, queued messages and forks retain their identity across the updated gateway records.

**Offline state upgrade required before using the bundled gateway with existing data.** Gateway config is now 27, Bot state 8, checkpoint JSON 19 and checkpoint SQLite schema 13. Protocol 91 is unchanged. Installation and startup do not convert old state automatically.

Follow the [0.16.27 offline upgrade instructions](https://github.com/citizenhicks/mobius/blob/mobius-v0.16.27/scripts/README-portable-upgrade.md): stop the gateway and all state writers, retain verified backups, and test a disposable copy before applying the tools to explicit state paths. Do not delete gateway state to resolve an upgrade error. The tools preserve journals and unrelated settings, but cannot recover the meaning of old encrypted compaction summaries removed from active context; upgrades across separate files are not atomic.
